description: Get the launch transaction of a prepared draft for a given wallet (method B/C). EVM: returns {chainId, to, data, value} (and an ERC-20 approve to send first when the pair currency is a token): send it from exactly that wallet within expires_at (the server-signed launch terms live 30 minutes; call again for fresh ones). Solana: returns the inputs (solana_launch) the local @idosgames/mcp turns into the transaction (build_launch_tx / send_launch_tx). The wallet becomes the draft's creator: only a launch from it can finish this game. After sending, call submit_launch_tx with the hash.

launch_id.description: LaunchID (the game's TitleID) returned by prepare_token_launch.

wallet.description: Address of the wallet that will sign and send the launch (EVM 0x..., Solana base58). It becomes the token creator.

name: build_token_launch_tx
title: Build the launch transaction
